name: Deendayal_dhakad
description: Indexes Telegram channel/group media into MongoDB so users can search via inline mode. Includes admin tools, force-subscribe, and rich stats.

ADMINS.description: Space-separated list of admin user IDs or @usernames.

CHANNELS.description: Space-separated IDs or @usernames of channels/groups to index.

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Channel ID (e.g., -100xxxxxxxxxx) for bot logs. Bot must be admin.

AUTH_USERS.description: Space-separated IDs/@usernames allowed to use inline search. Leave empty for public.

AUTH_CHANNEL.description: Force-subscribe channel ID. Users must join to use the bot. Leave empty to disable.

DATABASE_URI.description: Primary MongoDB connection string (SRV or standard).

COLLECTION_NAME.description: MongoDB collection name for media index.

PICS.description: Space-separated Telegraph image URLs for /start splash.

USE_CAPTION_FILTER.description: Set to true to index/search by message captions.

AUTO_FFILTER.description: Enable automatic filter replies in groups (true/false).

SINGLE_BUTTON.description: Show filename & size in a single button (true/false).

SPELL_CHECK_REPLY.description: Suggest titles when query is misspelled (true/false).

scripts.postdeploy: echo 'App deployed. Configure env vars, then scale worker if needed.'
